reports.title: ImmunityBio Reports Label Expansion and Additional Global Approval with Q3 2026 Net Product Revenue of $48.7 Million, Up 53% Year-Over-Year and First Nine Months U.S. Revenue Up 92% to $143.6 Million

desk.headline: ANKTIVA sales up 53% to $48.7m but below estimates; net loss widens to $184.6m; no financial guidance
results: Bladder-cancer drug ANKTIVA sold $48.7m, up 53%; nine-month sales of $143.6m were up 92%.
R&D rose $20.3m to $71.5m and SG&A rose $17.7m to $54.0m on trials, staff and commercial spending.
Net loss grew to $184.6m from $67.3m, mostly a $77.9m non-cash fair-value charge on a convertible note and warrants as the share price rose; adjusted net loss was $97.9m.
Ended September with $334.3m of cash and marketable securities after using $75.3m in operations in the quarter.
FDA widened ANKTIVA's label on 14 Oct to papillary-only BCG-unresponsive disease; a BCG-naïve trial cohort met its main goal, with a filing planned this quarter.

guidance.summary: The company gives no financial guidance. It plans to file for approval in BCG-naïve bladder cancer in Q4 2026.

watch: The BCG-naïve sBLA filing planned for Q4 2026
Uptake of the expanded US label and early European sales
Cash burn against $334.3m on hand, and swings from fair-value charges
